concepts.why: The presence of a systolic murmur, a large defect with left-to-right shunt, and a step-up in oxygenation from the superior and inferior vena cava to the right atrium are consistent with an atrial septal defect.

support_spans: Complete right bundle-branch block with normal PR interval
concepts.why: The ECG finding of a complete right bundle-branch block with a normal PR interval is consistent with right bundle branch block.

support_spans: Fragmented QRS with a notch on the R wave in inferior leads
concepts.why: The ECG finding of a fragmented QRS with a notch on the R wave in inferior leads is consistent with fragmented QRS complex.
It explains the uncovered finding of a dilated right atrium and right ventricle.
